cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: C1 ether-sulfate chassis (Sodium Laureth Sulfate @2) with two prominent buffers (Coco-Glucoside @3, Cocamidopropyl Betaine @4) and no reinforcing strong anionic (C3, C4, C1). Refatting (Glyceryl Oleate @8, Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil @6) is a counter-signal only and does not move the convention.

conditioningLevel.rationale: High: a prominent payload lipid (Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil @6) converges with a prominent cationic polymer (Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride @9) = W-RICH rich architecture for conditioning (E3 reading), supported by weak refatter Glyceryl Oleate @8 and humectants Glycerin @12, Panthenol @13, Sodium Hyaluronate @18 (Section 5 high anchor, W-RICH). C2 itself is not met (no separate pearlizing/fatty route), and the lipid sits right after the salt, so its share is likely small; moderate is the realistic neighbor.

excluded: Sorbitan Caprylate @10 (preservative booster, no deposition role)

weightPotential.counterevidence: W-RICH is established for weight (material Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil @6 + guar @9) - argues toward high; but reset is not limited.

Not low: two deposition families including a material lipid make 'lightweight' an understatement (W2).
